title: Flatness descends along an injective integral ring map for finitely presented modules
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma descends flatness of a finitely presented module along an injective integral extension, and the proof is a 30-line reduction to the finite Noetherian case. It chooses a presentation of the module, writes the entries of the presentation matrix as polynomials whose coefficients are finitely many elements of the base, and then decomposes the whole situation over a finitely generated subalgebra of the base with a finite subalgebra of the extension; flatness after base change is then inherited by one of these finitely generated pieces by the limit statement for flatness of finitely presented modules, the finite Noetherian case of the descent statement applies there, and the conclusion is pulled back by base change. The two reductions are the substance and both are displayed.
